Subject: CN-Summit booth spend — quote attached / need PO routing

Team —

We have a final quote from SummitWorks for the CloudNortheast Summit (booth, shipping, power, lead retrieval, and one 10x10 sponsor lounge). Total spend is $38,450. Attached: itemized budget + vendor quote. Key asks:

- Marcus: need PO created and formal spend cap approval. Please advise required cost center & GL code.
- Finance timeline: we need PO issued by 02/24 to lock in the early-bird rate (vendor requires PO prior to signing).
- Stephanie: confirm any line items that might shift (e.g., A/V vs. power) so Marcus can put the right descriptions on the PO.
- Aditya: confirm which sponsorship tier we will commit to (we recommended "Gold Plus"; see quote).

Notes: vendor will accept net-30 once PO is in place. There is a 50% deposit for booth space (expected $19,225). We may reimburse shipping via corporate card for urgent crates; flagging for reconciliation.

Attachments: [Attachment: SummitWorks_Quote_20260210.pdf (PDF, 220KB)], [Attachment: CN_Summit_Itemized_Budget_20260210.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

Thanks — Hannah

Subject: Re: CN-Summit booth spend — quote attached / need PO routing

Hannah —

Thanks for the details and attachments. Quick questions so we can get the PO out:

1) Cost center and project code — which marketing cost center should bear the spend? (We typically use MKT-REG-NE for regional events.)
2) GL account — is this trade show expense (GL 6402) or sponsorship/marketing (GL 6105)? If the booth includes sponsor deliverables (logo placement, session slot), we'd classify as sponsorship (6105).
3) Approver chain — do you want me to route to Marketing Director or VP of Growth for sign-off?

Once I have those, I'll create a PO draft and share for signature. If we need the deposit immediately, we can set a short-term pre-approval to issue a deposit PO.

Marcus
Senior Finance Manager
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Hannah / Steph —

We should lock Gold Plus. It includes the sponsor lounge access which is where we'll run customer meetings. Confirming budget OK from my side assuming the sponsorship comes from the events budget. If Finance wants to code as sponsorship (6105), that's fine.

Also: recommend we add an extra $2k contingency for on-site hospitality (client dinners/meet & greet). Happy to pull from my regional SDR/AE travel pool if needed, but prefer single PO for easier reconciliation.

—Aditya
